analysis_settings.question: Can native ShinkaEvolve improve chapter-aligned MPSO by adapting neutral population within each subswarm while retaining the published temporary-conversion schedule?
analysis_settings.scenario: 5 dimensions, 10 peaks, severity 1, period 5000, correlation 0, nexcess 1, 500000 counted objective queries
analysis_settings.development_cases: Reuse the eight book_mpso_schedule_v1 development pairs; these are development data, not fresh evidence.
analysis_settings.selection: Minimum development mean offline error among complete valid native programs including the target-5 seed; ties by earlier generation, then source SHA256.
analysis_settings.fixed_target_selection: Minimum development mean among targets 3,5,7; ties by lower numeric target (3,5,7). All start at five and change by at most one on each detected event.
analysis_settings.fresh_comparison_condition: A distinct selected native descendant strictly improves development mean over target 5 AND the best tested fixed target; it is not established execution-equivalent to either comparator.
analysis_settings.fresh_freeze_order: Freeze exact selected and reference sources, selected fixed target, and this analysis before generating eight fresh environment/optimizer seed pairs excluding historical identities.
analysis_settings.execution_aliases: Use one physical execution for established identical sources/execution rules. Preserve nominal labels and recorded proof; do not infer equivalence merely from similar mean error.
analysis_settings.effect_direction: Negative selected-minus-reference offline error favors the selected population rule.
analysis_settings.case_weighting: Equal weight for each of eight independent paired cases in the one chapter condition.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: Independent environment/optimizer case pair, preserving paired outcomes together.
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive 95% percentile interval of paired mean; numpy default_rng; no particle/update/environment-level resampling.

analysis_settings.influence: Retain every case. Report largest absolute case contribution, fraction of net mean where defined, and every completed-environment contribution; no outlier removal.
analysis_settings.behavior: Requested-target distributions at detected changes, realized-neutral-count distributions over subswarm updates, additions/removals, measured total particles and swarm counts over counted queries, query-category shares, spread of simultaneous neutral counts and how target requests differ between swarms. Give cases equal weight; pooled totals are labeled.
analysis_settings.legacy_target_5_diagnostics: Compatible historical target-5 traces may be augmented deterministically: five neutral and six total particles per extant swarm, zero resizing, request five on recorded detections. Do not invent missing observations; record reconstructed diagnostic fields separately from originally measured fields.
analysis_settings.recovery: Use saved actual query offsets after environmental boundaries. Exclude initialization environment; average environments within case then give cases equal weight. Never interpolate unrecorded immediate error.
analysis_settings.population_trajectories: Use counted objective evaluations as time axis. Traces share a registered 100-query grid; average cases at actual common recorded queries and show within-case neutral count spread. No simulation replay.
analysis_settings.examples: Prospectively recorded first update, first detected change and first updates reaching quarter, half and three-quarter budgets in each case. Also choose largest negative and largest positive completed-environment contributions, excluding initialization, with ties by case index then environment. These extreme examples are explicitly post hoc, not representative frequencies.
analysis_settings.development_interpretation: Repeated development cases informed selection; descriptive intervals do not correct selection bias and are not a continuation or significance gate.
analysis_settings.fresh_interpretation: Eight fresh independent pairs provide exploratory evidence in one chapter condition. A constant winner is population-size tuning. A conditional winner beating 3/5/7 does not establish superiority to all constants, the causal value of adaptation, historical table replication, or superiority of Shinka or an engine feature.
analysis_settings.no_automatic_extensions: No new regime, shorter horizon, baseline-validation study, repeated search, parameter sweep or fresh stage when trigger fails.

best_descendant_interpretation: Lowest-error complete descendant, even if worse than the seed. This is an explanatory comparison and does not replace selection including the seed.

best_descendant_behavior.interpretation: Requests occur only at counted detections; at most one particle changes per decision. Update observations are not independent replicates. Population changes are within swarms, not inter-swarm transfers.

best_descendant_episode_influence.interpretation: Post hoc influence description; all epochs and cases remain retained. Complete trajectories differ.
